content: मध्यम {%a.%} [मध्ये भवः म] .²1 Being or standing in the middle, middle, central; पितुः पदं मध्यममुत्पतन्ती <ls>V. 1. 19</ls>; मध्यमोपलम् <ls>Ki. 9. 2</ls>; so मध्यमलोकपालः, मध्यमपदम्, मध्यमरेखा <ab>qq. vv.</ab> .²2 Intermediate, intervening; नाप्नोद्योऽयं मध्यमः प्राणस्तानि ज्ञातुं दध्रिरे <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 21</ls>. .²3 Middling condition or quality, mediocre; as in उत्तमाधममध्यम. .²4 Middling, moderate; तेन मध्यमशक्तीनि मित्राणि स्थापितान्यतः <ls>R. 17. 58</ls>. .²5 Middle-sized. .²6 Neither youngest nor oldest, the middle-born (as a brother); प्रणमति पितरौ वां मध्यमः पाण्डवोऽयम् <ls>Ve. 5. 26</ls>; ततोऽर्धं मध्यमस्य स्यात् तुरीयं तु यवीयसः <ls>Ms. 9. 112</ls>. .²7 Impartial, neutral. .²8 Mean (in <ab>astr.</ab>). .²9 Belonging to the meridian. .{@-मः@} .²1 The fifth note in music. .²2 A particular musical mode. .²3 The mid-land country; see मध्यदेश. .²4 The second person (in grammar). .²5 A neutral sovereign; धर्मोत्तरं मध्यममाश्रयन्ते <ls>R. 13. 7</ls>. .²6 the middle-most prince; मध्यमस्य प्रचारं च विजिगीषोश्च चेष्टितम् <ls>Ms. 7. 155</ls>. .²7 the middle character in plays. .²8 The governor of a province. .²9 An epithet of Bhīma; (<ab>cf.</ab> मध्यमव्यायोग). .{@-मा@} .²1 The middle finger. .²2 A marriageable girl, one arrived at the age of puberty. .²3 The pericarp of a lotus. .²4 One of the classes of heroines (Nāyikās) in poetic compositions, a woman in the middle of her youth; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>S. D. 100</ls>. .²5 A central blossom. .{@-मम्@} .²1 The middle. .²2 The waist; तदैव यन्न दग्धस्त्वं धर्षयंस्तनुमध्यमाम् <ls>Rām. 6. 111. 24</ls>. .²3 The defectiveness. .²4 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) The meridian ecliptic point.
